title: PayPal Cancelled?
summary: I’ve been subscribed for years, probably ever since google reader went away. Today I got a ‘PayPal cancellation notice’ on my payment. Did it just expire or were PayPal removed as a payment option?
body_markdown:
[Trekkie](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/Trekkie)


August 19, 2026, 4:11am 1


I’ve been subscribed for years, probably ever since google reader went away. Today I got a ‘PayPal cancellation notice’ on my payment. Did it just expire or were PayPal removed as a payment option?


[jgbishop](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/jgbishop)


August 24, 2026, 12:19am 2


You should have received another email from Samuel (I had this happen too). The cost of a NewsBlur subscription is going up slightly, and the PayPal subscription cannot be renewed at the higher price.


[samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay)


August 24, 2026, 2:21am 3


Sorry I’m just back from a week out. Yep the price increased (it actually increased eight years ago but I’m just now getting to upgrading everybody). PayPal wouldn’t let me ask you to upgrade so I had to cancel so you could manually upgrade. Stripe of course made it easy.


[Trekkie](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/Trekkie)


August 24, 2026, 1:41pm 4


ah ok no worries, I’ll switch to stripe. I think PayPal was the only option way back when and I’ve been trying to use them less anyway.
